WFTX-TV, Channel 4, Fort Myers - Naples, Florida
At FOX 4, we focus on community based journalism. Our Community Correspondents work in the same neighborhoods everyday, so they can build connections with the people who live there. That leads to better relationships and a better understanding of what truly matters in your community. 

News Tips: Call 239-574-NEWS or email news@fox4now.com 

Please send Press Releases to news@fox4now.com
